g.text: Zero-shot, one-shot and few-shot prompting. What examples teach a model, what they
teach it by accident, and how to measure whether they helped.
lessons/07-zero-one-few-shot/run.py (the prompts live here; the exercises ask you to
The story below is the setting. LANTERN is the local model; the case files are the text you send it.
Digital forensics has pulled the messages from Reyes's work phone, 1 to 14 March. Forty-eight of them.
Okafor has already sorted them by hand into three piles: threat, logistics, personal. Varma does not
want his piles. She wants to know whether LANTERN can sort the next phone on its own, because there will
be a next phone. "Show me how often it agrees with Daniel," she says. "And show me where it doesn't."
M01 2026-03-01 08:12 Ana (wife) Don't forget Leo's parents evening at 6. He's nervous about
M02 2026-03-01 09:40 Gulf Tug dispatch Two tugs confirmed for Mardale Star, Pier 9, 14:00.
M03 2026-03-01 22:15 unknown +88 301 You asked about Northwind. Some questions are expensive.
M04 2026-03-02 07:55 R. Malhotra Berthing plan for next week is on the shared drive.
. What the model actually receives in few-shot
few-shot as chat turns (first 2 of 6 examples)
user: Message from unknown +88 301: "You asked about Northwind. Some questions are expensive."
user: Message from Gulf Tug dispatch: "Two tugs confirmed for Mardale Star, Pier 9, 14:00."
user: Message from unknown +88 301: "The March invoice will be paid on time. Make sure of it."
Each example is a user turn and the
assistant reply. The model continues the pattern.
The task is `TASK` in run.py. The example sets are the `EASY` and `BORDER` lists.
, changes how many messages look like threats.
Examples cost tokens on every call. They earn their place only if accuracy moves.
Leo got a B in his maths test!! Call him.
Still on for the match Saturday? I'll bring the kids.
I can explain the Sabran trips. Don't put it in

Are you still at the office?
Read each disagreement before blaming the model. Some of Okafor's labels are judgement calls.
On its own the text is harmless. It is a threat only if you know what happened two hours later.

he did, even with a good accuracy score?

More detail: 'Try this' in lessons/07-zero-one-few-shot/README.md. Undo an edit with git checkout
<file>, or set every change aside with git stash.
Best prompt on this phone: few-shot, clear examples, 86% agreement with Okafor. The threats come from
one number, +88 301, the same prefix as Northwind's bank in Port Sabran. They start on 1 March and end
at 15:03 on 14 March with a place and a time: "Stairwell C. 23:30."
